queries.sql:
SELECT
        f.formula_id     AS "formulaId",
        f.account_code   AS "accountCode",
        COALESCE(a.account_name, f.account_code) AS "accountName",
        f.calc_type      AS "calcType",
        f.expression     AS "expression",
        f.time_operator  AS "timeOperator",
        f.alloc_basis    AS "allocBasis",
        f.sort_priority  AS "sortPriority",
        f.formula_source AS "formulaSource",
        f.ai_confidence  AS "aiConfidence",
        f.is_active      AS "isActive",
        f.updated_by     AS "updatedBy",
        f.updated_at     AS "updatedAt"
      FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.FORMULA_DEF f
      LEFT JOIN SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT a ON f.account_code = a.account_code
      WHERE f.is_active = TRUE
      ORDER BY f.sort_priority ASC, f.account_code ASC
